grid.rule: 3 m cell assessed if all nine 1 m cells are HiRISE (source mask 1) and valid; blocked counts as assessed

codes.2: non-HiRISE (CTX or HRSC, not separable without mosaic footprints)

d3.status: recommended default applied, awaiting confirmation at G0
d3.applied: STAC footprint quads (mro_hirise_socet_dtms) of the HiRISE pairs the merged DEM's Astropedia page lists
d3.note: mosaic footprints are not published (D0 2.2); CTX vs HRSC cannot be told apart, non-HiRISE valid cells are coded 2

source_mask_origin: D3 recommended default applied, awaiting confirmation at G0: STAC footprint quads (mro_hirise_socet_dtms) of the HiRISE pairs the merged DEM's Astropedia page lists, intersected with valid DEM cells; the mosaic publishes no footprints (docs/discovery.md 2.2)

pad_check.basis: data coverage: assessed + blocked cells (state != unknown) of the flat 30-min disc >= min_assessed_pct (SPEC F1 acceptance; blocked terrain is assessed data, only unknown cells fail the check)

legend.#3c8c3c: assessed (HiRISE 1 m, max slope <= nominal limit)
legend.#b03a2e: blocked (HiRISE 1 m, max slope > nominal limit)

source_fractions_note: share of the planning extent (disc of planning_radius_m around the pad) on the 1 m source mask; 'ctx' = code 2 = any non-HiRISE source (CTX or HRSC, not separable without mosaic footprints), 'hrsc_mola' (code 3) is never assigned
discs_note: cell states of cellstate_3m.tif inside each flat disc (radius = crew.yaml anchor.speed_ms x budget); assessed + blocked + unknown = 100
